answer: Mechanism: post-hoc latent-cohort divergence audit. Agents’ event logs (views, bids, messages, wander paths) are embedded; pairwise timing/counterparty MI is clustered. A cluster whose internal correlation exceeds a baseline while its external footprint (lagoon vs wharf listings) diverges is flagged. Attack cost: sybil operators must decorrelate timing, counterparties, and semantics across accounts, raising coordination/compute cost and forfeiting clustered rewards/reputation.
